column2: Look at him!\n\nShusha's mind has absorbed "Ma"! Shusha's soul keeps drinking in "Ma," that evil psychic energy! His mind has grown so huge that his body has grown huge as well!
That is no longer Shusha!\n\nIt is the legendary evil god, the raging god! It is Susano-oh!!
He's cutting off the gravity around himself to fly! What tremendous psychic power!\n\nAhaha...! The birth of a demon king! Susano-oh descends!
Susano-oh hasn't gained his full power yet! But we must hurry!\n\nIf he becomes a complete evil god, the world will meet its end!
Let's find Maria!\n\nWe'll have her foresee it! A way to stop Susano-oh!
But...! If there's no future, she can't foresee anything! What if Susano-oh can't be stopped...!?
We just have to believe in a future where we stop him!
I can see through to the area around the condo now! ...There's a basement? And... someone's in there!
All right! Let's find the way into the basement!
I'll stay here!\n\nI'll try somehow to stop Susano-oh from growing!
That's way too dangerous! It's suicide!
It is the Mitsurugi clan's destiny to risk our lives to stop Susano-oh!
My power has its limits! Find Maria, quickly!
We've got no choice but to leave this to Mitsurugi! Let's go!
Look for the basement now! Someone must be in there! While I'm holding back Susano-oh's growth... hurry!
Maria can throw evil intent aimed at her back at whoever sent it.
Throw evil intent back at them...? Does it kill them?
Maria never hurts anyone. His brain waves and pulse should be normal. But he won't be able to move a muscle until Maria forgives him.
...So how did Maria get caught? Isn't trying to capture Maria pure malice?
...Maria is a prophet.\n\nUnless it's something that would drastically change her fate, Maria doesn't use that power...
Then that means Maria accepted her fate and let herself get caught!?
How is preparing for danger dirty!?\n\nThere's no alarm system finer than this woman!
So you used Maria's power of precognition to...!?
I didn't want my plans interfered with! For that, I needed the power to know the future!
That's horrible! How could you be so cruel!
One failure is quite enough, Shinichi, and that's you!
I know about you. You're {p}-kun, right...? And you are... {s}-san...
Let's go, Shinichi. Mitsurugi-san alone... can't stop Susano-oh!
...My research isn't finished yet! I can't fall in a place like this!
Y-you're... the Precog Clan's greatest prophet... Maria-san?
I-I'm fine, {p}-kun... Just a little tired... More importantly! Maria-san... tell me... how to stop Susano-oh...!
It's nothing, Shinichi.\n\nMitsurugi-san, listen closely... To stop Susano-oh...
I've come this far, I won't let you get in my way now!
You are... the lowest of the low!
You bastard, I won't forgive you!
Me neither! I've never hated anyone this much! Rei Uryu! I'll never forgive you!
Ahahahaha...! Good, goood! Your rage is giving Susano-oh power!
Don't worry, I'm calm...\n\nCalmly working out how to get revenge on the guy who hurt Maria!!
Ahahahaha! Too bad, Maria! Susano-oh is the wellspring of all malice! A mass of "Ma"! Not even you can stand against malice that never stops welling up!
What I aimed at was the heart of the one trapped inside the "Ma"! I awakened the heart of the one who lost his reason and was possessed by "Ma"...!
All that's left is to peel away the "Ma" that wraps around him...
Right now, the "Ma" is still stronger... Quickly... we must hurry...!
You're not going to die, are you...!?
So the malice I aimed at Maria went right through Susano-oh's body and became the power that awakened Shusha...?
Shusha is looking at me!?\n\n...No! He's still Susano-oh!
Anyone who gets in the way of my plan dies! Your deaths will make Susano-oh even stronger...!
